name: EvoFox Ronin TKL Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
details: 🔧 Gasket Structure – Advanced 9-layer gasket design reduces noise, improves stability, and enhances tactile feedback for a premium typing experience.
🔗 Versatile Connectivity – Switch seamlessly between wired, 2.4GHz wireless, and Bluetooth modes; supports up to 5 devices for maximum flexibility.
🎛️ Pro Mod Hot-swappable Module – Customizable with silent Outemu Red Dust Proof Switches, ensuring smooth, durable, and personalized typing.
💻 Powerful Software – Advanced Windows software with on-board memory for full customization: program keys, macros, backlighting, and manage profiles.
🌈 Prism RGB Backlighting – Per-key RGB with 21 lighting effects and 'Audio Sync Mode' for immersive, personalized setups.
🔌 Detachable Braided Cable – Durable 1.5m Type-C cable with EMI ring ensures robust, interference-free connection and easy portability.

name: Kreo Hive 65
details: 🌈 RGB Lighting with Software Support – Fully customizable per-key RGB with dynamic effects, brightness control, and advanced software integration for personalized setups.
🎮 Anti-Ghosting Technology – Reliable key rollover ensures every keystroke is registered, even during fast-paced typing or intense gaming sessions.
⌨️ Double-Shot PBT Keycaps – High-quality keycaps with a textured finish that resist wear, fading, and shine, guaranteeing long-lasting durability and clarity.
🔌 Detachable USB Type-C with Cross-Platform Support – Reversible, durable Type-C cable enables easy portability and seamless use across Windows, macOS, Linux, and even mobile devices.
🖥️ Compact 65% Layout & Minimalist Design – Saves desk space while retaining essential keys; perfect for a clean, modern setup without sacrificing usability.
⚙️ Pre-lubed Switches – Smooth actuation and reduced friction deliver a refined typing experience with minimal rattle and consistent sound.
🪶 Gasket Mounted with 2-Layer Foam Dampening – Advanced mounting structure paired with dual foam layers reduces vibration and enhances acoustics for a softer, premium feel.
🔄 5-Pin Hot-Swappable PCB – Effortlessly swap switches without soldering, supporting a wide range of mechanical switches for maximum customization and longevity.

name: Cosmic Byte CB-GK-33 Astra
details: 🔄 Hot-Swappable Switches – The Astra Keyboard allows effortless swapping of switches, supporting Cherry MX, Gateron, Kailh, Outemu, and other 3-pin/5-pin compatible mechanical switches without soldering.
🔌 Wired + Bluetooth Connectivity – Use the keyboard in wired USB-C mode or wirelessly via Bluetooth, with support for connecting up to 3 devices simultaneously and quick switching between them.
⚡ 1000Hz Polling Rate – Experience ultra-fast response times with a true 1000Hz polling rate available in both wired and Bluetooth modes, ensuring competitive-level performance.
🔋 1800mAh Built-in Battery – Equipped with a long-lasting 1800mAh rechargeable battery, the Astra Keyboard offers extended usage without needing daily charging.
🌈 Per-Key RGB with Software Customization – Features 16.8 million color combinations, multiple dynamic lighting effects, and deep customization via dedicated software or keyboard shortcuts.
🎚️ Volume Roller – Conveniently adjust system volume with a smooth, tactile volume roller positioned at the top-right corner of the keyboard for quick control.
🔗 USB-C Connectivity – Modern, reversible USB-C cable ensures stable power and fast data transmission, while remaining durable and easy to replace.
⌨️ 67-Key Layout with Anti-Ghosting – Compact form factor retains essential keys while offering full anti-ghosting technology for accurate keystrokes in intense typing or gaming.
📏 Dual Adjustable Height – Ergonomic dual-angle adjustment lets you choose your preferred typing angle for comfort over long sessions.
🛡️ Scratch-Resistant Keycaps – Built with durable, scratch-resistant materials that maintain their premium look and feel even with heavy daily use.

name: Cosmic Byte CB-GK-24 Equinox Alturas
cons: Mixed experiences with the keyboard's software support
details: 🎮 8 Programmable Macro Keys – Assign single keystrokes or complex multi-key sequences instantly to any of the dedicated G-keys without needing extra software, giving you full control for gaming or productivity.
⚡ 4 Onboard Profile Keys – Instantly switch between personalized profiles with the dedicated M-keys, perfect for multiple users or different game/application setups.
🏗️ Engineered for Durability – Crafted with premium ABS keycaps mounted on a robust aluminum alloy frame, designed to withstand heavy daily use and long gaming sessions.
🖐️ Detachable Wrist Rest – Ergonomically contoured wrist rest provides superior comfort and reduced fatigue during extended play, and can be easily removed when not needed.
🎚️ Convenient Volume Roller – Smooth and precise volume control is at your fingertips with the top-right volume roller, ensuring distraction-free adjustments while gaming.
🌈 Limitless RGB Customization – Spectra Per-Key RGB offers 16.8 million colors with 12 pre-set lighting effects, plus the ability to assign unique colors to every key for a personalized look.
⌨️ Silky Anti-Fade Keycaps – High-quality keycaps designed with an anti-fade finish, ensuring crisp legends and a smooth typing feel even after long-term use.
⚡ 1000Hz Polling Rate – Ultra-fast 1ms response time ensures every keystroke registers instantly, making it ideal for competitive gaming.
🛡️ Full Anti-Ghosting Keys – Supports simultaneous keystrokes without conflicts, guaranteeing flawless execution of combos and commands.
🔄 Hot-Swappable Outemu Switches – Easily swap switches with compatible Outemu mechanical switches without soldering, giving you flexibility to experiment with different feels and actuation types.

name: Acer Predator Aethon 303
cons: Loud- not ideal for shared spaces
details: ⌨️ Full-Size 104 Keys Layout – Standard keyboard layout including dedicated media keys for quick access to volume, playback, and other controls. Equipped with Kailh Blue mechanical switches, delivering tactile feedback and an audible click for precision typing and gaming.
⚡ 100% Anti-Ghosting with N-Key Rollover – Every keystroke is registered accurately even during intense, fast-paced gaming when multiple keys are pressed simultaneously.
🎮 Programmable Keys & Macros – Customize key functions, create macros, and re-assign inputs to match your personal playstyle, ensuring full control in any game.

💡 RGB Illumination with 12 Effects – Features 12 dynamic backlight effects, a vibrant light bar surrounding the keyboard, and 5 pre-set gaming modes (fully re-customizable). Includes 3 sidelight effects for extra flair.
🎨 Extensive Customization – Choose from 8 single colors with 7 adjustable brightness levels and customizable lighting speed, letting you fine-tune the glow to match your setup.
🛡️ Built for Endurance – Rated for over 50 million keystrokes, ensuring long-lasting performance even under heavy daily use.
🔒 Key Lock Function – Prevent accidental presses during gameplay by disabling unnecessary keys at the press of a button.
💻 Software Compatibility – Fully compatible with Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10, and 11, supporting custom lighting and macro programming via software.
🔌 Premium Cable Design – Comes with a black braided cable featuring a gold-plated USB connector for enhanced durability and stable signal transmission. Cable length: 5.25 feet.

name: Redragon SU-RARA K582
details: 🎯 OUTEMU Red Switches – Equipped with pluggable OUTEMU Red switches, which are linear and smooth from top to bottom. These switches require less actuation force, making them ideal for fast-paced gaming and extended typing sessions.

⌨️ Full-Size 104 Keys with 100% Anti-Ghosting – Ensures accurate registration of every simultaneous keystroke, giving you precision in high-intensity gameplay. Fully programmable for custom macros and key reassignments.

🌈 Dynamic RGB Backlighting – Features 6 preset backlight themes and 18 lighting models, allowing you to personalize your setup. Supports 16.8 million colors with adjustable brightness using FN + Arrow keys.
💡 Advanced Lighting Modes – Non-breathing modes allow arrow key control for quick customization. Easily sync lighting effects to match your style or gameplay.
⚡ Professional Gaming Performance – No delay and no input errors thanks to the gold-plated USB port ensuring stable and fast data transmission.
🛡️ Extreme Durability – Rated for 50 million keystrokes, with a solid base and double-injection ABS keycaps built to withstand long-term gaming and typing use.
🎮 Macro & Software Support – Comes with intuitive software for easy macro setup and advanced lighting customization, enhancing both work and play efficiency.
🖐️ Ergonomic Comfort – Designed for extended gaming sessions with a comfortable layout that reduces hand fatigue.
💧 Water & Dust Resistant – Engineered with protection against accidental spills and dust buildup, extending the lifespan of your keyboard.

name: Logitech K580 Slim Multi-Device
details: 🖥️ Modern, Slim Design – Minimalist slim profile with a sleek look that enhances any desk setup, combining style and functionality.
🔄 Multi-Device Connectivity – Easy-Switch lets you pair and toggle between multiple devices such as computer, smartphone, and tablet via Bluetooth or the 2.4 GHz USB receiver.
⌨️ Compact yet Functional – Space-saving layout that still includes a number pad, providing all essential keys for productivity without clutter.
🤫 Whisper-Quiet Typing – Scissor-switch keys deliver fluid, laptop-style typing with ultra-quiet keystrokes for a distraction-free workspace.
🔋 Long Battery Life – Up to 24 months of reliable use with auto-sleep functionality to save power. Strong wireless range up to 10m via Bluetooth or USB receiver (may vary by usage).
🌍 Cross-Platform Compatibility – Works seamlessly with Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Supports familiar keyboard shortcuts across devices.
📱 Multi-Device Productivity – Type reports on your computer, then instantly switch to messaging on your phone or tablet with the Easy-Switch button.
🪶 Low-Profile Keys – Provides comfortable, laptop-like typing in a slim, lightweight build for effortless daily use.
⚡ Stable & Reliable Connection – Dual connectivity options ensure flexibility and secure wireless performance at home or office.

name: Redragon K617
details: ⌨️ 60% Compact Layout – Features 61 keys with a space-saving design, ideal for FPS gamers and efficient desk setups.
💸 Budget-Friendly – Affordable mechanical keyboard option without compromising essential features.
🔄 Hot-Swappable Switches – Pre-installed quiet red linear switches for smooth typing, with support for almost all 3-pin and 5-pin mechanical switches for easy customization.
🎨 Vibrant RGB Lighting – 20 preset backlighting modes with adjustable brightness and flowing speed directly from the keyboard. Fully customizable with 16.8 million RGB colors via software.
🖥️ Pro Software Support – Create custom lighting modes, effects, macros, and keybindings using Redragon software for optimized gaming and productivity.
🎮 FPS Gaming Optimized – Straight placement design ensures maximum mouse movement space with no interference, perfect for fast-paced FPS gameplay.
🔌 Wired Connection – Stable, ultra-light 430g build with a detachable ‘L’-shaped USB-C cable for easy portability and reliability.
🪶 Ultra-Lightweight Design – Weighing just 430g, making it comfortable to carry and suitable for compact gaming setups.

name: Portronics Hydra 10
details: 🔗 Dual Wireless Modes – Connect via Bluetooth 5.0 or 2.4 GHz with a USB nano dongle, offering flexible and stable connectivity.
📱 Multi-Device Compatibility – Works seamlessly with PCs, laptops, smartphones (iOS & Android), and tablets for maximum versatility.
🔄 Easy Device Switching – Pair up to 4 devices (3 via Bluetooth + 1 via dongle) and switch between them effortlessly with key commands.
🌈 RGB Backlighting – 16.8 million colors with up to 20 lighting modes, customizable directly using Fn + key commands.
🎮 Gaming Ready – Features anti-ghosting with linear red switches for smooth, responsive, and efficient gaming or typing.
⌨️ Compact 68-Key Layout – Ergonomic and portable mini design weighing just 586g, great for both work and gaming on the go.
🔌 USB-C Charging – Supports fast Type-C charging and can be used in wired mode while charging. A 1-hour charge provides up to 5 days of usage.
⚡ Hybrid Use – Designed to switch smoothly between productivity, leisure, and gaming with balance between portability and performance.

name: Redragon Kumara K552
details: ⚙️ Custom Mechanical Switches – Outfitted with Cherry Blue equivalent switches for tactile feedback, durability, and responsiveness, built for longevity and precision.
⌨️ 87-Key Compact TKL Layout – A 75% Tenkeyless design with all essential keys, saving desk space while maintaining full gaming and typing functionality.
💡 Double-Shot PBT Keycaps – Injection-molded keycaps ensure crystal-clear legends, uniform RGB lighting, and resistance to wear or fading over time.
🎮 Full n-Key Rollover – All 87 keys are conflict-free, allowing simultaneous keypresses for seamless gaming performance.
🔌 High-Speed USB Connection – Gold-plated, corrosion-resistant USB connector ensures a stable, lag-free connection for both gaming and productivity.
🛡️ Durable Build – Constructed with a metal alloy top plate and ABS frame with plate-mounted switches to withstand intense gaming sessions.
🌈 RGB Customization – Features 18 preset lighting modes, 9 color options, 5 brightness levels, plus software support for advanced RGB customization.
🔄 Hot-Swappable PCB – Supports 3-pin mechanical switches (compatible with Redragon and Akko) for easy customization and switch replacement.
🖥️ Multi-Use Design – Built not just for gaming but also optimized for typing accuracy and office productivity, reducing errors and enhancing comfort.
💧 Non-Slip Ergonomic Design – Splash-proof construction with adjustable rear feet ensures a comfortable typing angle and stability during use.
